name: Varbase Social Single Sign-On
description: Varbase feature that wires the Social Auth provider ecosystem (Google, Facebook, LinkedIn and others) into a site and themes a social-login block on the login and register pages.
project_description: Varbase Social Single Sign-On adds single sign-on to a Drupal site using an existing identity on a social networking service such as Google, Facebook, or LinkedIn. It is a thin Varbase feature built on the Social API / Social Auth ecosystem: it declares the provider modules as Composer dependencies and contributes theming so that a social-login block and per-provider buttons render on the login and register pages. It holds no OAuth logic of its own; client IDs, secrets, redirect URIs, and account linking are all configured in Social Auth and its per-provider modules. It can be installed on any Drupal site (Minimal or Standard profile), but is designed for and best used with the Varbase distribution. Sponsored and developed by Vardot. This 11.0.x release replaces the earlier OOP hook class and install recipe with plain procedural .module hooks and no longer requires vardot/varbase-patches.
